```c
void prg32_gfx_clear(uint16_t color);
```
Fill the whole game screen with one colour. Call it first in your draw function.

*Immediate-mode graphics and status bands:* Cartridge coordinates address the 320x200 viewport unless fullscreen mode is enabled by resident UI. Drawing is clipped; non-positive rectangle sizes draw nothing. `present` publishes the completed back buffer. Cartridge draw callbacks are already serialized by the runtime and normally should not acquire the graphics lock themselves. Snapshot rows copy RGB565 pixels into caller storage and return the number copied or a negative error. Band text is copied by the runtime. Fullscreen, persistent band configuration, and lock management are primarily resident firmware services and should be used cautiously by cartridges.

Portable PRG32 ABI 1.6 · feature: core

```c
void prg32_gfx_clear(uint16_t color);
```
Fill the whole game screen with one colour. Call it first in your draw function.

Before `call prg32_gfx_clear`: a0 = color (uint16_t).

Calling a PRG32 function from assembly (RISC-V ilp32): put the arguments in a0, a1, ... a7 (in order), then `call prg32_name`. The result comes back in a0. A call may change ra, t0-t6 and a0-a7, so save what you still need (and ra, if your function calls others) on the stack first; s0-s11 and sp keep their values. Keep sp a multiple of 16.

Immediate-mode graphics and status bands.

*Immediate-mode graphics and status bands:* Cartridge coordinates address the 320x200 viewport unless fullscreen mode is enabled by resident UI. Drawing is clipped; non-positive rectangle sizes draw nothing. `present` publishes the completed back buffer. Cartridge draw callbacks are already serialized by the runtime and normally should not acquire the graphics lock themselves. Snapshot rows copy RGB565 pixels into caller storage and return the number copied or a negative error. Band text is copied by the runtime. Fullscreen, persistent band configuration, and lock management are primarily resident firmware services and should be used cautiously by cartridges.
